scope: Binary64 minimax discovery on 2,106 rows: all 1,461 second/fourth rows and 645 pinned sixth-order D42 orbits. The 185 physical columns comprise the 151-column canonical base, one exact continuous-path generator, thirty earlier canonical additions, and three new canonical columns whose reduced-cost scores were independently certified strictly positive by 128-bit Arb against the parent 182-column mixed-order dual. This is not a theorem; any sub-1/3 candidate requires exact probability rationalization, a fresh Arb audit of all 2,106 rows, and a complete 63,133-orbit sixth-order separation scan.
